title: Analysis and design of a novel compound cross-section flexible hinge
abstract: Abstract                   This study proposes a novel hybrid flexure hinge with a straight segment and an elliptical-hyperbolic profile, achieving both high precision and flexibility. The influence of structural parameters on compliance is analyzed under small deformation assumptions. Theoretical compliance coefficients are derived and refined via finite element analysis. Compared with conventional hinges, the proposed design offers a superior balance between flexibility and accuracy. The refined formulas are applicable to various dimensions, with deviations from finite element results below 3% for axial compliance and within 0.5% for other coefficients. This work provides insights for precision flexure hinges in aerospace applications.
